prompt.en: Which short u spelling is right?

what_to_do.en: Tap the right spelling of the short u word.
what_to_do.ko: 짧은 u 단어의 바른 철자를 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Four unique whole-word spellings of the one short u word the stem names. Exactly one is correct. The other three misspell that same word by swapping the vowel, adding or dropping one letter, writing k instead of ck, or adding a silent e. A real-word distractor must not fit the stem. Do not put the correct spelling in the stem. No IPA and no lone sounds.

gold_items.stem: The hot yellow ball in the sky.
A little animal on a leaf.
This bird can swim on a pond.
You do this with two feet to go up.
<NAME> can use this on wet hair.
A baby bear is called this.
It is after spring and before the fall.

roots: Each item has four spellings of one short u word, and answer_index marks the only correct spelling.
Distractors misspell that same word by swapping the vowel, adding or dropping one letter, writing k instead of ck, or adding a silent e.
A distractor that is a real word must not fit the stem. The stem names only the correct word.
Use whole words only. Do not write IPA, slash sounds, or a vowel sound by itself.
Build each stem from the roots word list, allowed extra words, and <NAME> only, and do not show the correct spelling in the stem.
Keep the scene in school, home, food, pets, play, family, or weather, with no brand names.

tier_rules.1: Easy CVC words such as cup, bug, and sun. Stems of four to seven words. Distractors swap the vowel or add an obvious extra letter.
tier_rules.2: Grade 2 blends and ck endings such as jump, brush, and duck. Stems of six to nine words. Distractors are one letter off.
tier_rules.3: Near misses only: a silent e that makes u long, as in cub and cube, or a two-syllable word such as summer with one letter wrong.

cvc_u.en: Short u is spelled with the letter u, as in cup, bug, and sun.
cvc_u.ko: 짧은 u는 글자 u로 씁니다. cup, bug, sun이 그 예입니다.

ck_spell.en: After a short vowel, use the letters ck at the end, as in duck.
ck_spell.ko: 짧은 모음 뒤에는 duck처럼 ck로 끝냅니다.

blend_u.en: Keep every letter. Short u is the letter u in the middle of the word.
blend_u.ko: 글자를 빠뜨리지 마세요. 짧은 u는 단어 가운데의 글자 u입니다.

no_silent_e.en: This word has a short u and no silent e. A silent e would make the vowel long.
no_silent_e.ko: 이 단어는 짧은 u이고 묵음 e가 없습니다. 묵음 e가 있으면 모음이 길어집니다.

two_syllable.en: This word has two parts. Spell the short u in the first part, then the ending.
two_syllable.ko: 이 단어는 두 부분입니다. 앞부분의 짧은 u를 쓰고 끝도 맞추세요.
